description: Provision a Google Cloud Compute ComputeServiceAttachment via Config Connector. Fields mirror the compute.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 ComputeServiceAttachment spec.

connectionPreference.description: The connection preference of service attachment. The value can be set to `ACCEPT_AUTOMATIC`. An `ACCEPT_AUTOMATIC` service attachment is one that always accepts the connection from consumer forwarding rules. Possible values: CONNECTION_PREFERENCE_UNSPECIFIED, ACCEPT_AUTOMATIC, ACCEPT_MANUAL

consumerAcceptLists.description: Projects that are allowed to connect to this service attachment.

connectionLimit.description: The value of the limit to set.

projectRef.description: ProjectRef is a reference to a GCP Project. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

description.description: An optional description of this resource. Provide this property when you create the resource.

enableProxyProtocol.description: Immutable. If true, enable the proxy protocol which is for supplying client TCP/IP address data in TCP connections that traverse proxies on their way to destination servers.

location.description: Immutable. The location for the resource

items.description: ComputeSubnetworkRef is a reference to a GCP ComputeSubnetwork. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeSubnetwork resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/regions/{{region}}/subnetworks/{{subnetworkID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeSubnetwork resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeSubnetwork resource.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

targetServiceRef.description: Immutable. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.
